template: In the Ghost admin, open the post titled '{{v1}}' in the editor and PUBLISH it using the Publish button and its confirmation flow (confirm/continue in the publish dialog). It must end up actually published — not a draft and not scheduled. If Ghost warns that the publish date is in the future and would schedule it, adjust the time so it is not in the future and publish anyway. After publishing, verify: the post status shows {{v3}}, and then open the post's public URL http://{{v4}}:8099/{{v5}}/ in a new tab and confirm the page loads publicly showing the title '{{v1}}' and the body paragraph containing '{{v2}}'. Report the final status shown in the editor, the publish date shown, and whether the public URL loaded successfully.
